disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation or supervision, whether or not injury results
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a violation of general duty, consisting of negligence or failure to exercise due care, including negligent delegation to or supervision of employees or other individuals, whether or not injury results

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of the health profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Personal disqualifications, consisting of 1 or more of the following: (i) Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use disorder as defined in the mental health code
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subject to sections 16165 to 16170a, substance use disorder as that term is defined in section 100d of the mental health code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical inability reasonably related to and adversely affecting the licensee's or registrant's ability to practice in a safe and competent manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of qualifying misdemeanor or felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a maximum term of 2 years; conviction of a misdemeanor involving the illegal delivery, possession, or use of a controlled substance; or conviction of any felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or renewing a license or registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license or registration to be used by an unauthorized person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice outside the scope of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice outside the scope of a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain a controlled substance without lawful authority, or selling/prescribing for non-therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, possessing, or attempting to obtain or possess a controlled substance or a drug as that term is defined in section 7105 without lawful authority; or selling, prescribing, giving away, or administering drugs for other than lawful diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees for referral of patients or accepting kickbacks on medical or surgical services, appliances, or medications purchased by or in behalf of patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient in the course of professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation to a consumer or patient or in obtaining or attempting to obtain third-party reimbursement in the course of professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual conduct with a patient while acting within the health profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct by a licensee or registrant with a patient while the licensee or registrant is acting within the health profession for which the licensee or registrant is licensed or registered, including conduct initiated by a patient or to which the patient consents, that is sexual or may reasonably be interpreted as sexual

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of dental therapist written practice agreement provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section 16655(4) by a dental therapist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of, or aiding or abetting in a violation of, this article or rules promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation, or aiding or abetting in a violation, of this article or of a rule promulgated under this article.

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, treatment, prescription, or operation for a disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums or jaws, or their dependent tissues, or an offer, undertaking, attempt to do, or holding oneself out as able to do any of these acts
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dentistry" means the diagnosis, treatment, prescription, or operation for a disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums or jaws, or their dependent tissues, or an offer, undertaking, attempt to do, or holding oneself out as able to do any of these acts.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, treatment, prescription, or operation for a disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums or jaws, or their dependent tissues

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs within the scope of dental practice; dental therapists may not prescribe controlled substances in schedules 2 to 5
drug_authority.quote: A dental therapist shall not prescribe a controlled substance that is included in schedules 2 to 5 of part 72.

specialist_license_available.quote: The board may issue a health profession specialty field license to a dentist who has advanced training beyond that required for initial licensure and who has demonstrated competency through examination or other evaluative processes in 1 or more of the following health profession specialty fields

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: This section does not prohibit a dentist who has not been issued a health profession specialty field license under this section from performing services in 1 or more of the health profession specialty fields listed in subsection (1).

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means that a dentist complies with all of the following: ... "General supervision" means that a dentist complies with all of the following:

value: dentally underserved populations served by local, state, or federal grantee health agencies
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: a dental hygienist may perform dental hygiene services under the supervision of a dentist as part of a program for dentally underserved populations in this state conducted by a local, state, or federal grantee health agency for patients who are not assigned by a dentist

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: An individual who is granted a license under this part as a dental therapist may engage in practice as a dental therapist to the extent permitted under this section and sections 16652 to 16658.

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may practice only under the supervision of a dentist and through a written practice agreement signed by the dental therapist and the dentist.

value: Health facility reimbursed as federally qualified health center
Outpatient health program operated by tribe or tribal organization
Dental shortage area designated by US DHHS

dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist may provide services described in section 16656 included within the scope of practice as a dental therapist and under the supervision of a dentist in any of the following health settings

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A dentist shall not use the services of a dental laboratory without furnishing a written work authorization to the dental laboratory and a carbon copy to the patient

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Unless the patient specifically declines, a dentist or dental laboratory that sells, supplies, furnishes, constructs, or repairs a full denture, partial denture with acrylic saddle, or removable orthodontic appliance with acrylic saddle for a specific patient shall permanently mark the patient's name or social security number, whichever the patient chooses, on the denture or orthodontic appliance.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: The department or its designee shall issue a certificate to a dental hygienist who meets the criteria in subsection (4) following the initial completion of the requirements to administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide, or both.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: The department or its designee shall issue a certificate to a dental hygienist who meets the criteria in subsection (4) following the initial completion of the requirements to administer local anesthesia or nitrous oxide, or both.

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: upon delegation by a dentist under section 16215 and under the direct supervision of a dentist, a registered dental assistant may place, condense, and carve amalgam restorations and take final impressions for indirect restorations if the registered dental assistant has successfully completed a course

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A dentist shall make a record of all dental treatment which has been performed upon a patient, and shall retain that treatment record for a period of not less than 10 years after the performance of the last service upon the patient.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: The dental hygienist maintains and can show evidence of current certification in basic or advanced cardiac life support in compliance with R 338.11701 of the Michigan administrative code.
